subject: Prepay drawdown ops — ledger mapping & EU VAT routing
messages:
From: Olivia Harris <olivia@acme.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Annual prepay — PO and VAT questions

Hi Jasmine / Vivek,

Thanks for the demo last week. Finance is preparing the PO for the committed prepay (FY27). A few quick questions before we lock the ledger: 

- We expect to wire a single prepay amount for the calendar year and draw down monthly. Can you confirm the invoice cadence Redwood expects so we can align accounting entries?
- From our tax team: for EU entities (Austria + Germany) we need to know whether Redwood will be invoicing gross VAT or if reverse-charge applies.
- We also need a short mapping (ledger account / invoice description) so our AP system can match payments to the prepaid balance.

I've attached our initial PO (Acme_PO_2027.pdf). If you can send a one-page ops plan and the invoice file names you'll issue, that would be ideal.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 30m if useful.

Olivia Harris
Head of Finance, Acme Corp
olivia@acme.com

Attachment: Acme_PO_2027.pdf (application/pdf, 148KB)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Harris <olivia@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-21T08:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — PO and VAT questions

Hi Olivia — thanks, and congrats on getting the PO started.

High-level answers up front:
1) Invoice cadence: We will issue a single upfront invoice for the committed prepay (net amount) on receipt of the PO, then provide a monthly drawdown statement (non-invoice) that lists the token/usage draw for that month. For accounting reconciliation we can also provide monthly invoices if you require them — that would convert the upfront payment into a credit balance that gets drawn down via monthly invoice offsets.
2) VAT routing (EU): Redwood issues invoices from our EU fiscal entity for customers registered in the EU. For B2B Acme entities with a valid VAT ID, we typically apply reverse-charge (net invoice) — but we need the VAT IDs per legal entity to confirm. If any location requires gross VAT (B2C or local rules), we will flag and invoice gross.
3) Ledger mapping: attached is a short matrix with recommended invoice descriptions and ledger account codes we suggest (redwood-prepay-drawdown-matrix.xlsx).

Next steps / asks:
- Please send the legal entity names + VAT IDs for each Acme operating entity that will be covered by the prepay.
- Confirm whether you prefer: (A) single upfront invoice + monthly statements (preferred for cash) or (B) single upfront invoice + monthly invoices that offset the credit (preferred for monthly P&L).
- Let us know billing contact and AP email for invoice delivery.

I attached the matrix and a short EU VAT guidance doc. I can join a 30m call Wednesday if that helps.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-prepay-drawdown-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 32KB); eu-vat-routing-guidance.pdf (application/pdf, 95KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Finance Team <finance@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-22T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Annual prepay — PO and VAT questions

Team — forwarding Acme's request. Quick proposed ops:

- Issue Invoice A (Prepay) upon PO receipt: Invoice number PREPAY-ACME-2027-01; invoice will reference Acme PO# and list total committed USD.
- Create a monthly drawdown report (PDF) dated the last business day of month listing: beginning credit balance, tokens consumed (units), cost per unit, draw amount, ending balance.
- Optional monthly invoice flow (if customer elects): Issue offsetting invoice with negative amount that consumes the prepaid credit.

Ledger mapping (suggested):
- Prepay ledger account: 2101 — Deferred Revenue (Prepaid Services)
- Monthly recognition: 4005 — Revenue — Model Inference
- AP remittance matching: include PO# and 'PREPAY-ACME-2027' on each invoice line.

I've sketched the sample file names we'll deliver in the Drive link Jasmine shared. If Finance sees any tax or recognition constraints on issuing a single large invoice vs monthly offsets, call them out.

-Vivek

Thanks — quick tax annotations based on entity list Vivek will share:

- Austria (Acme AT GmbH) — B2B with valid VAT ID: reverse-charge applies; invoice net.
- Germany (Acme DE GmbH) — B2B VAT reverse-charge if VAT ID present; ensure supplier VAT registry check.
- UK (Acme UK Ltd) — post-Brexit: if Acme UK is VAT-registered, reverse-charge for services may apply but local obligations differ; confirm local tax counsel.

Notes:
- We'll need a redwood EU fiscal invoice (EU VAT format) to land in Acme AP. If Acme requires gross VAT for any entity, the invoice will show VAT line and we will collect.
- Please have Acme provide the VAT validation screenshots or VIES lookup results for each VAT ID to speed PO processing (some AP teams insist on that).

Olivia — thanks for the PO and the quick turnaround. Summary and next steps below (tl;dr at top).

TL;DR
- Redwood will issue an upfront prepay invoice (PREPAY-ACME-2027-01) on receipt of your PO and remittance. We will issue monthly drawdown statements on the last business day of each month.
- For EU B2B entities with valid VAT IDs (please send IDs + VIES screenshots) Redwood will invoice net under reverse-charge. If any entity requires gross VAT, we'll flag and invoice gross.
- Attached: consolidated drawdown ops checklist + reporting filenames.

Consolidated plan:
1) Acme to confirm: legal entity names + VAT IDs + preferred workflow (single upfront + statements OR monthly offsetting invoices).
2) Redwood to issue PREPAY invoice after PO approval and provide wire instructions on the invoice.
3) Monthly: on the last business day we publish drawdown PDF to your AP shared folder and email acme-payments@acme.com with the monthly statement.
4) Tax: Rishi will prepare EU invoice templates and the vat-annotations.csv for your tax team to validate.

Attachments included for AP: redwood-prepay-drawdown-matrix.xlsx; eu-vat-routing-guidance.pdf; vat-annotations.csv

Meeting: booked the 30m slot if you'd like a walkthrough — link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-redwood-prepay-review

If this looks good I'll continue with PREPAY invoice generation once we receive the signed PO and VAT IDs.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
